mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payroll employment above 200,000 per month signals robust labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 200,000 per month for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained PAYEMS growth above 200,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained RSAFS increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decrease in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals an overheating labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).
